previous_goal_turn: Progress:ADI V8 cost planning only; no synthesis. This stage resumes declared stream-vs-mapping isolation.

decision.conclusion: Independent original-marginal stream barely changes low-carrier HF spread; conditional decoding on that SAME stream remains much worse. Independent-stream L/R also regresses. Finite frozen paths, not physical or listening causation.
decision.next: Known-first controls for fixed-P/vary-uniform, fixed-uniform/vary-P and full joint conditional decoding, preserving signed interaction. Then reuse all original frozen source paths through original observer to constrain a temporal representation; no rate/rho/rank/strength/unwrap sweep or fixed-P audible promotion. Native audio/listening/C and one-driver integration remain separate gates.
